headline: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's benchmark KSE-100 index rose 1,707.89 points, or 0.96%, to 179,581.76 by 1pm on Monday amid buying in banks, cement, oil and gas and power stocks, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Benchmark index gained 0.96% by 1pm on Monday

caption:
PSX stocks surge as KSE-100 jumps 1,707 points! 📈
According to Business Recorder, the Pakistan Stock Exchange's benchmark KSE-100 index was at 179,581.76 at 1pm on Monday, up 1,707.89 points or 0.96%. Buying was seen in automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, oil and gas exploration companies, OMCs and power generation, with HUBCO, MARI, OGDC, POL, PPL, HBL, MEBL, NBP and UBL trading higher. Last week the index gained 3,987.19 points (2.3%) to close at 177,873.88, helped by falling international oil prices and strong workers' remittances.
